name: opt-in-macro-keep-control-drop
description: macroPolicy 'keep' stores an unexpanded {{macro}} as received; controlCharPolicy 'drop' stores '' for a value with an inner control character.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (opt-in, #64): defaults stay macro rejection (ruling #15) and control-character deletion (ruling #16). Semver: additive opt-in parse option (minor); defaults, CLASSIFIER_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged.
